# Requirements Quality Checklist: Spec-Tracked GitHub Issues

**Purpose**: Validate completeness, clarity, consistency, and measurability of the spec, plan, and contracts (PR review, standard depth)
**Created**: 2026-11-04
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md), [plan.md](../plan.md), [contracts/](../contracts/)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

## Requirement Consistency

- [ ] CHK001 Is the point of issue creation consistent between the spec (engineer creates the issue before `/speckit-specify`, FR-001) and the plan (new action `x_github:issue:create` files the issue from the form)? [Conflict, Spec §FR-001, Plan §Summary]
- [ ] CHK002 Do the section-by-section authoring requirements (FR-004) and the single-form page in the contract (six fixed fields) describe the same experience? [Conflict, Spec §US2, Contracts/spec-form]
- [ ] CHK003 Are the "required sections" in the Assumptions (scenarios, requirements, success criteria, assumptions) reconciled with the form fields (type, title, story, solution, context, acceptance criteria)? [Conflict, Spec §Assumptions]
- [ ] CHK004 Is the issue body content defined consistently between FR-006 ("reflects completed spec sections") and the fixed body layout? [Consistency, Spec §FR-006]
- [ ] CHK005 Does the spec's "issue body contains the spec content" (US1) align with the contract body that holds only form answers? [Consistency, Spec §US1]

## Requirement Clarity

- [ ] CHK006 Is "identify the spec" on the issue (FR-002) defined with a concrete mechanism or marker? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-002]
- [ ] CHK007 Is "non-closing reference" defined with the accepted PR reference syntax and examples? [Clarity, Spec §FR-007]
- [ ] CHK008 Is "detectable" for a missing PR reference defined (who detects, when, how reported)? [Ambiguity, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK009 Is the heading format (`##Proposed Solution` without a space) confirmed as intended rather than an open question? [Ambiguity, Research §D5]
- [ ] CHK010 Is the 'story sentence' format ("As a ____, I can ____") stated as guidance or as validated input? [Clarity, Contracts/spec-form]
- [ ] CHK011 Is the meaning of "without needing external documentation" (SC-004) defined with how it is evaluated? [Measurability, Spec §SC-004]

## Requirement Completeness

- [ ] CHK012 Are requirements defined for how the spec records the issue number and link, including where it is stored? [Gap, Spec §FR-002]
- [ ] CHK013 Is the mechanism that determines "an issue already exists" for a spec (FR-003) specified, including the key source for `idempotencyKey`? [Gap, Spec §FR-003, Research §D4]
- [ ] CHK014 Is the update behavior defined for an edited spec (which fields sync, and who or what triggers it)? [Gap, Spec §FR-003, Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK015 Are requirements defined for how PRs get their reference (template, branch naming, automation) beyond "guidance and detection"? [Gap, Spec §FR-007]
- [ ] CHK016 Is it specified which user story or FR owns the form page, since the spec contains no requirement for the form's fields? [Traceability, Gap]
- [ ] CHK017 Are requirements for the "Create feature spec" template location and registration traceable to a spec requirement? [Traceability, Plan §Summary]
- [ ] CHK018 Is the label requirement defined for when the label (e.g., `feature`) does not exist or the user cannot create labels? [Gap, Research §D4b]

## Acceptance Criteria Quality

- [ ] CHK019 Can SC-001 ("exactly one linked issue") and SC-002 (100% of PRs link) be objectively measured, with a defined data source and time window? [Measurability, Spec §SC-001, §SC-002]
- [ ] CHK020 Is SC-003 testable given that merge-close behavior depends on PR text and repository settings? [Measurability, Spec §SC-003]
- [ ] CHK021 Is an acceptance criterion defined for the optional-field outcomes (empty additional context, default acceptance criteria)? [Gap, Research §D5]
- [ ] CHK022 Are requirement IDs provided for user-story acceptance scenarios so they trace to FRs? [Traceability]

## Scenario & Edge Case Coverage

- [ ] CHK023 Are requirements defined when the engineer lacks permission to create issues, beyond listing it as an edge case? [Coverage, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK024 Are partial-failure requirements defined when the issue is created but a later scaffolder step fails (and the reverse)? [Coverage, Recovery, Gap]
- [ ] CHK025 Are requirements defined for retry or re-run after failure, including expected visible outcome? [Coverage, Recovery, Spec §FR-003]
- [ ] CHK026 Are requirements specified for an abandoned spec's issue (labeling, status) beyond "remains open"? [Coverage, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK027 Are GitHub API rate-limit, timeout, and network-failure behaviors specified? [Gap, Exception Flow]
- [ ] CHK028 Are requirements defined for very long titles or bodies and special characters or Markdown injection from form input? [Edge Case, Gap]
- [ ] CHK029 Are requirements defined for a repository with issues disabled or an archived repository? [Edge Case, Gap]

## Non-Functional Requirements

- [ ] CHK030 Are the token scopes required by the user for issue creation documented? [Gap, Plan §Constraints]
- [ ] CHK031 Is behavior specified when the user credential secret is missing or expired? [Gap, Exception Flow, Plan §Constitution IV]
- [ ] CHK032 Is the statement "FR-010 must not store credentials" tied to specific verification criteria? [Measurability, Spec §FR-010]
- [ ] CHK033 Are accessibility expectations for the form (radio, textarea labels and help text) specified? [Gap]

## Dependencies & Assumptions

- [ ] CHK034 Is the dependency on the external template repository (`backstage-github-speckit-feature`) and its release or sync process documented? [Dependency, Plan §Summary]
- [ ] CHK035 Is the assumption that the spec repository equals the issue repository validated against the template's `repoUrl` input? [Assumption, Spec §Assumptions]
- [ ] CHK036 Is the scope boundary between `/speckit-specify` (CLI) and the scaffolder template workflow stated explicitly? [Ambiguity, Spec §US1]
- [ ] CHK037 Is the exclusion of existing specs 001–007 consistent with how duplicate detection treats older specs? [Consistency, Spec §Assumptions]

## Notes

- Mark items `[x]` only after review confirms the requirement-quality criterion is satisfied
- Leave items unchecked when they still require clarification, correction, or reviewer evaluation
- `/speckit-implement` reads checklist checkbox state as a gate and must not modify markers
- `checklists/requirements.md` has a separate built-in lifecycle maintained by `/speckit-specify` and `/speckit-clarify`
- Add comments or findings inline
- Items are numbered sequentially for easy reference
